saliencePolicy.high: sourceMatch AND topicMatch AND titleMatch AND NOT titleExcluded
saliencePolicy.sourceMatch: highSalience.sourceIds must contain the source id
saliencePolicy.titleMatch: titleAny is non-empty and at least one case-insensitive term matches; titleAll terms must also match
saliencePolicy.titleExcluded: any case-insensitive titleNone term prevents promotion
